metadata.displayName: H07 - Audit all Public IPs require approved DDoS Network Protection: Effect
metadata.description: Read-only evaluation.

metadata.displayName: H07 - Audit all Public IPs require approved DDoS Network Protection: Approved DDoS protection plan resource IDs
metadata.description: Required list of full resource IDs of approved DDoS Network Protection plans. A public IP is approved only when ddosSettings.protectionMode is Enabled and ddosSettings.ddosProtectionPlan.id is in this list. An empty list reports every public IP.

metadata.displayName: H07 - Audit all Public IPs require approved DDoS Network Protection: Accept virtual-network-inherited protection
metadata.description: When true, public IPs whose protectionMode is VirtualNetworkInherited (or omitted) are not reported, because the plan association is on the virtual network and cannot be read from the public IP. The default false reports them.

metadata.displayName: H21 - Selected Premium Firewall Policies must explicitly enable approved IDPS mode: Effect
metadata.description: Read-only evaluation; the IDPS traffic mode is a separate configuration.

metadata.displayName: H21 - Selected Premium Firewall Policies must explicitly enable approved IDPS mode: Approved Premium policies and IDPS modes
metadata.description: Required nonempty policy IDs and accepted IDPS modes. Accept Alert, Deny, or both according to approved inspection architecture.

metadata.displayName: H26 - Web Application Firewall (WAF) policy must be enabled for Prevention mode: Effect
metadata.description: Audit reports WAF policies that are disabled or not in Prevention mode. Deny blocks creating or updating such a policy.
